name: Reference period length
description: Different recall windows (e.g. 7-day vs. 12-month).

name: Temporal framing
description: Point-in-time vs. habitual vs. retrospective framing (e.g. last week vs. usually).

name: Calendar alignment
description: Fixed calendar periods vs. rolling reference periods (e.g. calendar year 2025 vs. past 12 months).

name: Concept definition
description: Different meaning of core term (e.g. employment including or excluding unpaid family work).

name: Operationalization
description: Different behavioral indicators for nominally the same concept (e.g. 12-item vs. single-question food insecurity measurement).

name: Boundary conditions
description: Different thresholds or cutoffs (e.g. full-time defined as 35+ vs. 40+ hours).

name: Scope inclusions
description: Different components counted (e.g. income including or excluding capital gains).

name: Universe definition
description: Target population differs (e.g. civilian noninstitutional vs. all residents).

name: Frame exclusions
description: Different sampling frame exclusions (e.g. group quarters, territories).

name: Age bounds
description: Different age eligibility (e.g. 15+ vs. 16+ vs. 18+).

name: Geographic scope
description: Different geographic coverage (e.g. 50 states vs. 50 states plus territories).

name: Scale type
description: Fundamentally different response formats (e.g. binary vs. 5-point Likert).

name: Category structure
description: Different numbers or boundaries of categories within the same scale type.

name: Anchoring/labels
description: Different verbal anchors or category labels.

name: Numeric vs. verbal
description: Numeric scales vs. labeled categories (e.g. 0-10 slider vs. frequency labels).

name: Interview mode
description: Different data collection modes (e.g. CATI vs. web self-administered).

name: Question routing
description: Different skip patterns affect who answers and in what context.

name: Contextual priming
description: Preceding questions affect interpretation.

name: Proxy response
description: Different rules for proxy vs. self-report.

name: Coding schemes
description: Different classification systems (e.g. SOC 2010 vs. SOC 2018).

name: Derived variables
description: Different construction algorithms for composite measures.

name: Documentation gaps
description: Insufficient metadata to assess comparability.
